thread:
Maria A.: Hey team — SeedLab (seed-stage ML infra startup) just asked for a 3-week extension on their trial plus a top-up. Security review pushed the POC start out by two weeks so their credits burned through. They’re asking for an extra $3k in credits and +21 days. Any objections? Link to account: https://app.redwood.ai/customers/seedlab (internal)
Jon S.: Quick context from the POC side — they’re running the 8k-context model for chat + high-frequency embedding calls. Current trial was consumed by embedding warmup & a couple of long-run sessions. If we don’t bump the quota they’ll hit a hard stop mid-eval.
Sam R.: Policy note — default trial = 14 days. Exceptions need RevOps signoff + AE justification. Please include ARR expectation, whether they’re in the startup program, and the exact ask (amount + duration + conditions).
Maria A.: Details: ask = $3k credits, extend 21 days. They say if POC is successful they’ll move to a 3-month pilot (estimated $2k/mo). They are in our startup program (seed, YC S21). Previously got a 1k credit allocation.
Nisha K.: Tech suggestion to reduce required top-up: recommend switching embedding model to small-embed on the POC, enable prefix caching, and cap generation max_tokens to 1024. That combo typically drops token burn ~30–45%.
Nisha K.: Example prompt/SDK tweak to cap tokens:
```
client.responses.create({
  model: "rwd-8k",
  input: prompt,
  max_tokens: 1024,
  use_prefix_cache: true
})
```
Oliver L.: Legal check — we can approve credits, but anything > $2k that’s tied to a commitment requires a short pilot addendum (no SLA changes, limited term). Also prefer card-on-file for recovery if they churn. No major privacy blockers surfaced.
Sam R.: Proposed one-off: grant $3k credits + 21-day extension, conditioned on (1) card on file, (2) signed 3-month pilot addendum, (3) POC start within 7 days of extension. RevOps will auto-expire credits if conditions not met. Can AE confirm customer contact & start date?
Maria A.: Confirmed contact: contact@seedlab.ai. Target POC start: 2025-03-15. I’ll send addendum and collect card. I also asked the customer to adopt Nisha’s embedding suggestion to stretch credits.
redwood-bot: Deal desk ticket created: #DD-4182 by Sam R. :white_check_mark:
Sam R.: Conditional approval granted. I’ve updated the Deal Desk entry and set expiry rules. Please move to "approved - pending addendum" in the pipeline. :thumbsup:
Maria A.: Thanks everyone — I’ll follow up once the signed addendum and card are in."
